license_required.quote: No person shall engage in, or offer to engage in, contracting work in the Commonwealth unless he has been licensed under the provisions of this chapter.

type.quote: The Board for Contractors shall be composed of 16 members as follows: one member shall be a licensed Class A general contractor; the larger part of the business of one member shall be the construction of utilities; the larger part of the business of one member shall be the construction of commercial and industrial buildings; the larger part of the business of one member shall be the construction of single-family residences; the larger part of the business of one member shall be the construction of home improvements; one member shall be a subcontractor as generally regarded in the construction industry; one member shall be in the business of sales of construction materials and supplies; one member shall be a local building official; one member shall be a licensed plumbing contractor; one member shall be a licensed electrical contractor; one member shall be a licensed heating, ventilation and air conditioning contractor

umbrella_agency.value: Department of Professional and Occupational Regulation
umbrella_agency.quote: "Department" means the Department of Professional and Occupational Regulation.

age_minimum.quote: who is at least 18 years of age and who has successfully completed the oral or written examination required by the Board on behalf of the contractor

moral_character_required.quote: information demonstrating that the applicant possesses the character and minimum skills to properly engage in the occupation of contracting

required.quote: The application shall contain, at a minimum, the applicant's name, place of employment, and business address; and information on the knowledge, skills, abilities and education or training of the applicant.

experience_source.quote: The application shall contain, at a minimum, the applicant's name, place of employment, and business address; and information on the knowledge, skills, abilities and education or training of the applicant.

exams.name: Tradesman examination (HVAC)
exams.notes: Required for individual HVAC tradesman license; oral or written exam on general knowledge of the trade.
exams.quote: the applicant shall be required by Board regulations to take an oral or written examination to determine his general knowledge of the trade in which he desires licensure

exams.name: Contractor designated employee examination
exams.notes: Required for Class A and Class B contractor license; oral or written exam on general knowledge of contracting including statutory and regulatory requirements. The Board also requires a master tradesman license as a condition of HVAC contractor licensure.
exams.quote: the proposed designated employee shall be required by Board regulations to take an oral or written examination to determine his general knowledge of contracting, including the statutory and regulatory requirements governing contractors in the Commonwealth

interval_years.quote: A license for a tradesman shall be valid for three years from the date of issuance.

required.quote: The Board shall require evidence of knowledge of code changes as a prerequisite to renewal of any certificate or license issued under this article.

value: evidence of knowledge of code changes
topical_requirements.quote: The Board shall require evidence of knowledge of code changes as a prerequisite to renewal of any certificate or license issued under this article.

available.quote: the regulatory boards within the Department of Professional and Occupational Regulation shall, upon application by an individual, recognize licenses or certificates issued by another state as fulfillment of qualifications for licensure or government certification in the Commonwealth

requirements.value: Must hold a current and valid license in another state for at least 3 years in a similar scope; must have passed an exam and met education/training/experience standards; no pending investigations; no disqualifying criminal record; no discipline except minor financial penalties; pay applicable fees.
requirements.quote: The individual holds a current and valid professional or occupational license or government certification in another state in a profession or occupation with a similar scope of practice, as determined by the board in the Commonwealth; The individual has held the professional or occupational license or government certification in the other state for at least three years

credential_type.quote: No individual shall engage in, or offer to engage in, work as a tradesman as defined in § 54.1-1128 unless he has been licensed under the provisions of this article.

is_mandatory.quote: No individual shall engage in, or offer to engage in, work as a tradesman as defined in § 54.1-1128 unless he has been licensed under the provisions of this article.

title_protection.quote: Practicing or attempting to practice as a tradesman, liquefied petroleum gas fitter or natural gas fitter provider in the Commonwealth, except as provided for in this article, is prohibited and shall constitute the commission of a Class 1 misdemeanor.

scope_protection.quote: No individual shall engage in, or offer to engage in, work as a tradesman as defined in § 54.1-1128 unless he has been licensed under the provisions of this article.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of statutes or regulations governing the practice of licensed contractors.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The Board shall have the power to require remedial education, suspend, revoke, or deny renewal of the license or certificate of any contractor who is found to be in violation of the statutes or regulations governing the practice of licensed or certified contractors in the Commonwealth.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having a substantial identity of interest with a contractor whose license has been revoked or not renewed.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The Board may suspend, revoke, or deny renewal of an existing license or certificate, or refuse to issue a license or certificate, to any contractor who is shown to have a substantial identity of interest with a contractor whose license or certificate has been revoked or not renewed by the Board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of unemployment or workers' compensation provisions.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: the Board may suspend, revoke or deny renewal of an existing license or certificate, or refuse to issue a license or certificate to any contractor who violates the provisions of Chapter 5 (§ 60.2-500 et seq.) of Title 60.2 and Chapter 8 (§ 65.2-800 et seq.) of Title 65.2.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Contracting for or bidding on work without a license or without the proper class of license.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Contracting for, or bidding upon the construction, removal, repair or improvements to or upon real property owned, controlled or leased by another person without a license or certificate, or without the proper class of license as defined in § 54.1-1100 for the value of work to be performed.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Attempting to practice contracting without authorization.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Attempting to practice contracting in the Commonwealth, except as provided for in this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Presenting or attempting to use the license or certificate of another person.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Presenting or attempting to use the license or certificate of another.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Giving false or forged evidence to the Board in an application for issuance or renewal of a license.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Giving false or forged evidence of any kind to the Board or any member thereof in an application for the issuance or renewal of a license or certificate.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Impersonating another or using an expired or revoked license.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Impersonating another or using an expired or revoked license or certificate.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation involving fraudulent or improper or dishonest conduct occurring during a declared state of emergency.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: If the Board finds any person licensed under the provisions of this chapter to be in violation of a statute or regulation involving fraudulent or improper or dishonest conduct as defined in § 54.1-1118, which violation occurred while engaged in a transaction initiated arising from a declared state of emergency

disciplinary_grounds.description: Intentional misclassification of workers as independent contractors.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: any contractor who is found to have intentionally misclassified any worker is subject to sanction by the Board

bonding_required.quote: In lieu of compliance with subsection B, an applicant may demonstrate financial responsibility by electing to obtain and maintain a bond in the amount of $50,000.

gas_appliance_certification_required.quote: "Liquefied petroleum gas fitter" means any individual who engages in, or offers to engage in, work for the general public for compensation in work that includes the installation, repair, improvement, alterations or removal of piping, liquefied petroleum gas tanks and appliances (excluding hot water heaters, boilers and central heating systems which require a heating, ventilation and air conditioning or plumbing certification) annexed to real property.

natural_gas_facilities_installation_auth.quote: "Natural gas fitter provider" means any individual who engages in or offers to engage in work for the general public for compensation in the incidental repair, testing, or removal of natural gas piping or fitting annexed to real property, excluding new installation of gas piping for hot water heaters, boilers, central heating systems, or other natural gas equipment which requires heating, ventilation and air conditioning or plumbing certification.

financial_responsibility_demonstration_m.quote: As proof of financial responsibility, the applicant shall demonstrate compliance with the minimum net worth requirement fixed by the Board in regulation by providing either: 1. A financial statement on a form prescribed by the Board... or 2. A balance sheet reviewed by a certified public accountant... In lieu of compliance with subsection B, an applicant may demonstrate financial responsibility by electing to obtain and maintain a bond in the amount of $50,000.

license_number_on_permits_required.quote: It shall be unlawful for the building official or other authority to issue or allow the issuance of such permits unless the applicant has furnished his license or certificate number issued pursuant to this chapter or evidence of being exempt from the provisions of this chapter.
